summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K disclosing the fifth amendment to its senior secured revolving credit facility with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. The amendment increases aggregate commitments from $2.6025 billion to $3.1275 billion, raises the accordion feature to $4.5 billion, reduces the applicable margin on borrowings to 1.75% from 1.875%, and extends the revolving period and maturity to four and five years from closing. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
